confirm.discardAll.en: Discard ALL staged and unstaged changes in {{count}} paths? Added and untracked files will be deleted; tracked content returns to the current commit (or an empty Index before the first commit).
confirm.discardAll.zh-CN: 丢弃 {{count}} 个路径中的全部暂存和未暂存更改？新增文件和未跟踪文件将删除；已跟踪内容恢复至当前提交，尚无提交时清空暂存区。

confirm.discard.en: Discard Unstaged Changes in {{count}} file(s)? Untracked files will be deleted; Index content and Staged Changes remain.
confirm.discard.zh-CN: 放弃 {{count}} 个文件的未暂存更改？未跟踪文件将被删除；Index 中已暂存的更改会保留。

confirm.resetHard.en: HEAD, Index and working files will change; uncommitted content can be lost.
confirm.resetHard.zh-CN: HEAD、Index 和工作区文件都将改变，未提交内容可能丢失。

confirm.resetMixed.en: HEAD and Index will change; working files remain.
confirm.resetMixed.zh-CN: HEAD 和 Index 将改变，工作区文件保留。

confirm.resetSoft.en: HEAD will change; Index and working files remain.
confirm.resetSoft.zh-CN: HEAD 将改变，Index 和工作区文件保留。

confirm.forcePush.en: Push with force-with-lease? Published branch history may be replaced.
confirm.forcePush.zh-CN: 使用 force-with-lease 推送？已发布的分支历史可能被替换。

confirm.forceDeleteBranches.en: Force deletion may remove the last branch referencing unmerged commits.
confirm.forceDeleteBranches.zh-CN: 强制删除可能使未合并提交失去分支引用。

confirm.dropStash.en: Drop {{selector}}? Its saved uncommitted changes may become unreachable.
confirm.dropStash.zh-CN: Drop {{selector}}？保存的未提交修改可能无法再恢复。

confirm.forceRemoveWorktree.en: Forced removal may delete uncommitted files.
confirm.forceRemoveWorktree.zh-CN: 强制移除可能删除未提交的文件。

confirm.abort.en: Abort the current {{kind}}? Conflict-resolution changes can be discarded.
confirm.abort.zh-CN: Abort 当前 {{kind}}？解决冲突时的修改可能被丢弃。

confirm.detachedCheckout.en: Checkout {{target}} as Detached HEAD? New commits will not belong to a branch until you create one.
confirm.detachedCheckout.zh-CN: 切换到 {{target}} 并进入 Detached HEAD？新提交不会属于分支，请及时创建分支保存。

confirm.stashDetachedCheckout.en: Stash Changes and Checkout {{target}} as Detached HEAD? The Stash will be retained for you to apply.
confirm.stashDetachedCheckout.zh-CN: Stash 更改后切换到 {{target}} 并进入 Detached HEAD？Stash 会保留，供之后应用。

confirm.restoreOriginalHead.en: Git will attempt to restore the operation start state at {{head}}. Pre-existing local changes may prevent full restoration.
confirm.restoreOriginalHead.zh-CN: Git 将尝试恢复到操作开始时的 {{head}}；操作前已有的本地修改可能影响完整恢复。

confirm.unsavedFiles.en: {{count}} file(s) have unsaved editor changes. Git commits the staged disk content.
confirm.unsavedFiles.zh-CN: {{count}} 个文件在编辑器中有未保存修改。Git 提交的是磁盘上已暂存的内容。

confirm.unsavedSelectedFiles.en: {{count}} file(s) have unsaved editor changes. Selected unstaged files use their latest saved disk content; selected staged files use Index content.
confirm.unsavedSelectedFiles.zh-CN: {{count}} 个文件在编辑器中有未保存修改。所选未暂存文件使用最新已保存的磁盘内容；所选已暂存文件使用暂存内容。
